title: Reverse a singly linked list, iteratively and recursively
hint: Iteratively keep prev, curr and next pointers flipping each link; recursively reverse the rest and attach the head at the end.

title: Detect a cycle in a linked list (Floyd's cycle detection / slow-fast pointers)
hint: Move a slow pointer one step and a fast pointer two steps; if they ever meet there is a cycle, and fast reaching null means none.

title: Find the middle node of a linked list in one pass
hint: Advance a fast pointer two nodes while a slow pointer advances one; when fast reaches the end, slow is at the middle.

title: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list
hint: Use a dummy head node and a tail pointer, repeatedly attaching the smaller of the two current nodes, then append the leftover list.
